text: Complete supply chain tracking is particularly difficult in the mineral industry because of the prevalence of smelting during processing, which is why supply chain mapping for conflict mineral due diligence is costly, time intensive, and not entirely effective.
citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041
abstract: Complete tracking is particularly difficult in the mineral industry because of the prevalence of smelting during processing.
